items.note: The price moved in the Cubs' favor for no reason: the rotation is still Cabrera, Assad and a rehabbing Steele. Don't pay for a rotation that doesn't exist yet.
One ace on a 74-88 team. The market bought the headline. Too short.
The champs priced like a juggernaut. Repeating is hard and this price leaves nothing on the table.
Only a few spots behind the Cubs. The market already sees Pittsburgh as a real NL Central threat.

futures.note: DraftKings, Nov. 22 after the Skubal deal: Cubs +2200 (from +2500), tied for eighth-shortest; Oddschecker's best price is still +2500. Polymarket has them at 3%. Nothing moved overnight and still no Cubs arm added, so still a pass. Webb by trade plus Peralta or Rogers before Dec. 1 makes +2200 worth a look; nothing added makes it a fade.

pass: No Cubs game until the spring opener on Feb. 19. No daily pick in the offseason.
